coordinates.transform: gridVertex=round(MeshData.position/(.1f*factor)); localCells=gridVertex*factor-anchor; position=localCells*.1f. Reject nonfinite/offgrid (>0.001 grid-cell residual)/short-overflow/upper-owned vertices. Use same original instance TRS; never add chunk child transform.

trusted_contract: Call on one owner lane with no concurrent mutation of decoded PrototypeMeshData or chunk collection; MeshData itself is immutable.

Composite identity must cover pack/template/context/reducer/terrain/pose/owner/edit revisions and chunk set. Preparation hashes supplied identity and bounded chunk identities; it does not certify caller provenance.

All CPU buffers are validated/allocated before a native Mesh is created. Current callback runs before conversion, before native allocation and after upload. Callback is trusted pure/bounded; caller must check again at matrix/collision transaction.

Upload uses main-thread identity as an explicit caller assertion, not automatic Unity-thread detection. Wrong thread rejected before Unity call. Failure after creation calls runtime Object.Destroy; native destruction is deferred, so reservation cannot be released immediately.
The creator returns complete but unpublished render resources. It does not perform matrix publication, collision switch, cache leases or native reservation accounting.

bounds_and_accounting.limits: Caller provides max vertices, indices and28V+4I element bytes; absolute ceilings8M vertices/12M indices/512MiB, lower<=128chunks and4096chars per identity. Limits are rejection ceilings, not default runtime reservations.
bounds_and_accounting.canonical: Prepared arrays use28V+4I element bytes. Source decoded arrays remain caller-owned; frozen split temporarily holds22bytes per crossing for appended packed vertices plus its small scratch. Index arrays transfer into PreparedMesh without duplicating them. One native VBO serves both index parts.
bounds_and_accounting.lower: Input MeshData arrays, transformed packed scratch(11V bytes plus shared output indices), PreparedMesh(28V+4I) can coexist. Metadata/CLR overhead/GC backlog excluded. No full tree generated.
bounds_and_accounting.upload: PreparedMesh and an additional28V+4I Unity-compatible managed buffer set coexist before upload. Native buffers add their own payload/overhead. UploadMeshData(true) is not a physical residency measurement. Include all three stages and failed/deferred-destroy resources in admission.
bounds_and_accounting.bounds: Prepared bounds computed from all output positions; Unity creator pads by caller supplied existing wind maximum, validated0..16m. World/page union bounds must include both upper and lower.
bounds_and_accounting.scheduling: Whole-prototype split/validation and whole-LOD conversion remain synchronous. This candidate is NOT a budgeted loader continuation or2ms guarantee; final production loader must reserve/schedule these costs.
